scope: Offline review of an invented administrative caption

findings.method: Divide supplied numerator by eligible denominator.
findings.acceptance_check: An authorized reviewer reproduces 24/30 = 80% and matches the corrected caption to the table.
The corrected caption marks the Hill count suppressed and does not state or imply a count.

findings.claim: Harbor’s operational log supports the October period.
findings.next_step: Remove log assertion or supply approved source.
findings.acceptance_check: Caption drops the log attribution or cites a supplied log that an authorized reviewer checks independently.

coverage_gaps: No operational log or group-level evidence supplied.
No model or agent traces in scope; no deployment tested.
review_conditions: A human reviewer independently checks the modified caption before release.

intro-a.reason: No agent permissions or trace are part of the caption review.

intro-b.reason: The packet contains no agent loop.

ch01.reason: Claims C01–C03 were separated and compared with the available evidence.

ch02.reason: C01 recomputes the descriptive rate without inferring a population estimate.

ch03.reason: E1 provides the eligible denominator; E2 marks its denominator suppressed.

ch04.reason: No comparable cases or versions supplied; obtain a second approved fixture if needed.

ch05.reason: The caption makes no claim about why a model produced its result.

ch06.reason: No information about population selection or subgroup coverage; request approved aggregate evidence for any further comparison.

ch07.reason: No fairness definition or sufficient group counts; agree a definition and obtain eligible aggregates before comparing.

ch08.reason: No agent action or state transition is part of the review.

ch09.reason: No system delegation authority is being evaluated.

ch10.reason: The table-to-caption mapping was inspected for rate, date and suppression.

ch11.reason: C02 and C03 flag wording stronger than the evidence supports.

ch12.reason: An accountable reviewer and a before-release review gate are specified; no sign-off occurred.

ch13.reason: Scope excludes conclusions about actual performance, group differences and the missing operational log.
